governance_decisions.statement: Scoped productivity promotion is not universal HNK grammar and does not change lexical authority labels.
If approved, productive=true applies only to the validated L03 controlled activity utterance use; no other pattern is promoted.
Preserve VALI FROZEN and PARAZAMI WATCH lexical authorities.
Keep AN EN KE NE KU KUVAN SARU SALI DAYI TA outside this pattern.
Keep I usually... unresolved/null, SARU not equivalent to usually, and all person/tense/aspect/modality/habituality/frequency/negation/interrogative/zero-pronoun inference unlicensed.
If approved, open a separate curriculum-mapping eligibility gate and stop; do not reuse this approval.
